description:
## What
Add `Error::NameConstraintViolation { index: usize }` to `pkix_path::Error` in `pkix-path/src/lib.rs` and implement its `Display` message.

## Algorithm
- Add variant `NameConstraintViolation { index: usize }` to the `Error` enum
- Display: "name constraints violated at certificate index {index}"
- The index is the 0-based position in the chain slice where the violation was detected

## Acceptance criteria
- `pkix_path::Error::NameConstraintViolation { index: 2 }` compiles
- Display output matches expected string
- No other error variants changed
title: Add Error::NameConstraintViolation variant
